accepted_concepts.summary: Tilemap conversion must report unique tile count, normal/H/V/HV reuse, flip-dependent cells, priority intent and per-tile palette conflicts.
HBlank/line-scroll language must be converted into table ownership, scanline owner, update cadence, reset path and fallback.
Composite/CRT dither fusion can be intended, but gameplay must remain readable under declared capture profiles and fallback.
Temporal sprite flicker/multiplexing is a controlled degradation requiring priority rotation, non-critical use and motion validation.

rejected_or_not_absorbed.claim: VDP tile descriptor bit layout as new knowledge
rejected_or_not_absorbed.reason: Already covered by earlier 16 Tile curation, tilemap-attribute-director and SGDK/VDP docs.

rejected_or_not_absorbed.claim: High compression or 60 FPS guarantee from tile deduplication
rejected_or_not_absorbed.reason: Deduplication reduces tile pressure but does not prove DMA, runtime budget or frame rate without measured reports.
Rejected. Dither, Shadow/Highlight and palette tricks are not alpha blending.
Rejected unless mapped to an implementable owner, update route, reset and evidence plan.

rejected_or_not_absorbed.claim: Sprite flicker as automatic capacity expansion
rejected_or_not_absorbed.reason: Rejected. It is a last-resort degradation and must not affect critical gameplay readability.

required_followups_before_production: local fixture or project report proving the reports can be generated
VDP/VRAM/CRAM/SAT/DMA evidence when claiming budget or AAA readiness
human review before treating E1_text as mandatory canon beyond candidate rules
